name: KinFlo design frame adoption backlog
objective: Turn the current design research, Claude Desktop frame response, and captured Claude Code design pass into an implementation-ready backlog for the KinFlo OS super-admin shell and Client Site Studio without claiming live provider readiness.

providerBoundary.notes: This backlog is a local planning and validation artifact. It does not publish UI, execute live Convex, call providers, read secrets, or share client data.

claudeDesktopReview.promptBoundary: Sanitized product and design brief only. No secrets, private customer records, provider credentials, or raw local files were sent.
capturedSignals: Make the active tenant the first-viewport object, paired with environment badge, launch-readiness score, and one next decision.
Use a two-level navigation system: left rail for primary workspaces and horizontal tabs for workspace-specific configuration states.
Separate configuration, evidence, blocked actions, and decision gates into consistent visual registers.
Keep disabled controls visible with inline reason, unblock condition, and owner instead of hiding them in tooltips.
Use a persistent decision rail for approval gates and reserve the strongest accent color for decisions.
Make the Client Site Studio a three-region workbench: page tree, device-framed preview canvas, and context inspector or launch panel.
Unify visual QA, AI review, permissions, launch decision, and handoff into one launch panel instead of forcing operators to reconcile separate tabs.
Make mobile inspection first-class with 390px review, touch/truncation checks, fold-line awareness, and screenshot evidence.
Prioritize inline blocked reasons, unified launch panel, device-framed preview canvas, reusable evidence cards, AI-content watermarking, blast-radius confirmations, and tab state dots.
acceptedRecommendations: inline blocked-reason lines under disabled controls
unified launch panel for QA, AI review, permissions, launch, and handoff
device-framed preview canvas with fold-line and mobile toggle
reusable evidence-card component with provenance line
blast-radius confirmations for publish and handoff
tab state dots and gate-accent color system
claudeDesktopReview.nextAction: Convert the accepted recommendations into scoped provider-light UI phases, starting with first-viewport object signal and Client Site Studio workbench grid.

claudeCodeFramePacket.promptBoundary: Sanitized product/design packet and public design research only. No secrets, private customer records, provider credentials, production data, .env contents, or raw private files were sent.
claudeCodeFramePacket.nextAction: Continue the accepted provider-light deltas in order, with primary metric per Configure panel next after the Phase 152 lane anchor.

adoptionPrinciples: Make the active tenant, site, launch packet, or preview object visible in the first viewport.
Keep operational density calm: compact controls, small headings, clear status, and no decorative distraction.
Show what can be configured now, what is blocked, why it is blocked, who owns it, and what evidence unlocks it.
Treat proof, approval, rollback, and visual QA as first-class UI, not secondary notes.
Keep desktop and mobile inspection paths explicit before any client handoff.
Never imply hosted Convex, provider writes, campaign sends, domain attachment, invite delivery, lead writes, or public launch are active.

implementationBacklog.change: Create a tighter first-viewport command header that foregrounds selected tenant/site, data mode, launch posture, blocked live actions, and next human gate.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Browser QA confirms the active object and next gate are visible without scrolling at 1280x900 and 390x844.

implementationBacklog.change: Group tabs into operational lanes: Control, Build, Launch, Growth, Evidence, and Hosted Activation so users can scan the system by work mode instead of raw feature count.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Static validator confirms lane labels, existing tabs remain reachable, and no live action is enabled.

implementationBacklog.surface: Hosted activation and launch decision surfaces
implementationBacklog.change: Add a consistent right-side decision rail pattern for owner, required evidence, rollback, blockers, and disabled primary action across launch, hosted activation, and adapter switch views.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Focused validators confirm each decision rail includes owner, evidence, rollback, and disabled live-action copy.

implementationBacklog.change: Refine the Site Studio into a stable workbench grid: site rail, preview canvas, evidence/decision rail, and compact launch controls with fixed responsive constraints.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Desktop and mobile browser QA confirms no overlap, no horizontal overflow, stable preview dimensions, and disabled publish/handoff controls.

implementationBacklog.surface: Preview QA Studio and public preview links
implementationBacklog.change: Make mobile inspection a first-class mode with device, persona, journey stage, screenshot evidence, accessibility status, and launch decision visible together.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Mobile 390px browser QA confirms preview controls, evidence posture, and launch blocker copy are readable without text clipping.

implementationBacklog.surface: Visual QA evidence and launch decision packets
implementationBacklog.change: Turn visual QA, accessibility, performance, approval, and open-risk evidence into uniform proof cards that sit next to launch decisions.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Validator confirms every launch decision packet has QA evidence, open risks, approval checklist, rollback, and disabled launch action.

implementationBacklog.surface: Content, brand, navigation, asset, domain, integration, campaign, and AI configuration forms
implementationBacklog.change: Standardize configuration fields with concise labels, state badges, provenance notes, and disabled save/send/publish controls that explain the hosted gate.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Static validators confirm every configuration surface has activation evidence and blocked live action copy.

implementationBacklog.surface: Admin permission presets and onboarding readiness
implementationBacklog.change: Add a compact permission strip that shows who can see/edit/publish, what invite is blocked, and what client handoff artifact is still missing.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Validator confirms permission preset, onboarding readiness, and launch packet references stay connected by site key.

implementationBacklog.change: Keep Claude Desktop recommendations summarized in this backlog and maintain a sanitized Claude Code packet with current design research, auth status, redaction rules, and provider-light implementation gates.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Backlog and packet record captured response date, accepted recommendations, rejected recommendations, CLI auth status, source URLs, and implementation phase targets without exposing secrets.

implementationBacklog.change: Capture the repaired Claude Code two-frame critique as a summarized provider-light response and classify the accepted deltas for implementation.
implementationBacklog.validationGate: Validator confirms the response artifact, accepted deltas, prompt boundary, safety list, and provider gates without storing raw transcript text.
